OPTIONS=name:Maren,role:Barbarian,race:human,gender:male,align:neutral
OPTIONS=playmode:debug,!tutorial,!legacy,suppress_alert:3.4.3,time,whatis_menu,pile_limit:10,menucolors,autopickup,pickup_types:all
MENUCOLOR=" uncursed "=yellow
MENUCOLOR="spellbook"=brown
MENUCOLOR="wand of"=bright-blue

MENUCOLOR="^((dagger){1,}.{2,}) ^"=cyan&underline
AUTOPICKUP_EXCEPTION=">[[:space:]]{1,5}((\(?gold).)*a+"

AUTOPICKUP_EXCEPTION="of[[.a.]]$"
MSGTYPE=hide "^.$*"
MSGTYPE=show "It"
MENUCOLOR="^a{2,5}"=orange
